resources.string: You will be able to join as a guest with the room QR code on the TV.
You will be able to browse games as a guest on TV and invite friends with a room QR code.

Questions will be on TV; players will answer on their phones. Guests will join using the room QR code on TV. Some games require sign-in on TV. No phone sign-in is needed. QR joining and game launch are not available yet.
